description: Source code for a FreeType font driver handling BDF font files, including font loading, glyph rendering, character mapping, and font properties.

classes.name: BDF_CMapRec_
classes.description: Character map structure for BDF fonts, holding encoding table and related data.

methods.name: bdf_cmap_init
methods.description: Initializes a character map with font glyphs data.

methods.name: bdf_cmap_char_index
methods.description: Returns the glyph index for a given character code.

methods.name: bdf_cmap_char_next
methods.description: Returns the next character code and glyph index after a given code.

methods.name: bdf_interpret_style
methods.description: Interprets font style properties from BDF font data.

methods.name: BDF_Face_Done
methods.description: Frees resources associated with a BDF font face.

methods.name: BDF_Face_Init
methods.description: Initializes a BDF font face from a font stream.

methods.name: BDF_Size_Select
methods.description: Selects font size metrics based on requested size.

methods.name: BDF_Size_Request
methods.description: Handles size requests for the font face.

methods.name: BDF_Glyph_Load
methods.description: Loads a glyph into a glyph slot from the font data.

methods.name: bdf_get_bdf_property
methods.description: Retrieves a property from a BDF font face.

methods.name: bdf_get_charset_id
methods.description: Gets charset encoding and registry identifiers.
